verdict.rationale: Azure provides the building blocks: RBAC offers fine-grained, per-resource access scoping, and managed identities let workloads obtain Entra tokens without handling stored credentials. Entra app registration also secures REST calls. However, nothing in the evidence describes an agent-specific pattern, time-bound or expiring credentials, or guarantees that the agent cannot escalate its own privileges. Missing for 10: documented agent-credential patterns, explicit temporary/short-lived scoping guidance, anti-escalation controls (e.g., restricting role-assignment rights), independent hands-on corroboration.
